mapper.select:
SELECT `id`, `applicant_id`, `applicant_name`, `applicant_organization_id`, `applicant_organization_name`, `applicant_post_id`, `applicant_post_name`, `attendance_group_id`, `business_type`, `json_form`, `apply_time`, `apply_done_time`, `STATUS`, `update_business`, `tenant`, `deleted`, `create_by`, `creator_id`, `creator_type`, `create_time`, `update_by`, `updater_id`, `updater_type`, `update_time` FROM `flow_form_data` WHERE `business_type` = 'PERSONNEL_RECRUIT' AND `STATUS` = 'PASS'
AND `apply_done_time` BETWEEN #{param.period.begin} AND #{param.period.end}

SELECT `applicant_name` AS `staffName`, `applicant_post_name` AS `postName`, `applicant_organization_name` AS `organizationName`, REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(`json_form`,'$.assessScore'),'"','') AS `score`, REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(`json_form`,'$.assessResult'),'"','') AS `grade`, CONCAT(REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(`json_form`, '$.assessTime[0]'),'"',''),'~',REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(`json_form`,'$.assessTime[1]'),'"','')) AS `assessTime` FROM `flow_form_data` WHERE `applicant_post_id` LIKE CONCAT('%',#{id}, '%') AND `business_type` = 'PERSONNEL_PROBATION_ASSESS' AND `status` = 'PASS'
AND `apply_done_time` BETWEEN #{param.period.begin} AND #{param.period.end}

SELECT REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(f.`json_form`,'$.organizationId'),'"','') AS `organization_id`, s.`NAME` AS `staffName`, REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(f.json_form,'$.staffIds[0]'),'"','') AS `staffId`, REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(f.json_form,'$.postId'),'"','') AS `postId`, f.`applicant_name`, f.`apply_time`, f.`apply_done_time` FROM `flow_form_data` f LEFT JOIN `staff` s ON REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(f.`json_form`,'$.staffIds[0]'),'"','') = CONCAT('',s.`id`) WHERE f.`business_type` = 'PERSONNEL_REGULAR_WORKER' AND f.`status` = 'PASS' AND REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(f.`json_form`,'$.organizationId'),'"','') = #{id}
AND `apply_done_time` BETWEEN #{param.period.begin} AND #{param.period.end}

SELECT s.`NAME` AS `staffName`, REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(f.`json_form`,'$.postId'),'"','') as `post_id`, REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(f.`json_form`,'$.organizationId'),'"','') as `organization_id`, f.`applicant_name`, f.`apply_time`, f.`apply_done_time` FROM `flow_form_data` f LEFT JOIN `staff` s ON REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(f.`json_form`,'$.staffIds[0]'),'"','') = CONCAT('',s.`id`) WHERE REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(`json_form`,'$.postId'),'"','') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{id}, '%') AND `business_type` = 'PERSONNEL_LEAVE_OFFICE' AND f.`status` = 'PASS'
AND `apply_done_time` BETWEEN #{param.period.begin} AND #{param.period.end}

SELECT c.`NAME` AS `staffName`, a.`rotation_time`, a.`rotation_organization_id`, a.`organization_id`, b.`applicant_name`, b.`apply_time`, b.`apply_done_time` FROM `flow_form_data_details` a INNER JOIN `flow_form_data` b ON a.`flow_form_data_id` = b.`id` INNER JOIN `staff` c ON a.`staff_id` = c.`id` where a.`rotation_organization_id` = #{id}

SELECT f.`id` as `flowFormDataId`, f.`applicant_id`, REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(f.`json_form`,'$.staffIds[0]'),'"','') AS `staffId`, REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(f.`json_form` ,'$.time'),'"','') AS `time` FROM `flow_form_data` f WHERE REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(f.`json_form`, '$.staffIds[0]'),'"','') = #{staffId} AND f.`business_type` = #{businessType} AND f.`update_business` = 0 AND f.`status` = 'PASS'
